title: Get orders delivered
intro: Let's set up delivery, so your orders reach your customers.

steps.caption: Where you sell and ship from
steps.vo: Open Delivery. First, check where you sell, and where you ship from.

steps.caption: Find delivery partners
steps.vo: Tap Find delivery partners to see delivery companies that cover your area.

steps.caption: Compare partners
steps.vo: Compare their ratings, prices and how fast they deliver. Every partner is checked by Shopinbos.

steps.caption: Add a partner
steps.vo: Open a partner to see their rate card, then tap Add partner.

steps.caption: Or let customers pick up
steps.vo: You can also let customers pick up from you, for free.

outro: Now your customers see delivery prices at checkout.
